summary.text: Gavin Lobmeyer is a Democratic candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A risk manager, he advanced from the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Gavin Lobmeyer said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born and raised in Wyoming and has spent his career in public service.
He said he is running so that young people see a future in Wyoming, and he named preserving community, honoring heritage and building for the next generation as his key messages.
His stated policy priorities include apprenticeships and skilled trades, lowering the cost of living, affordable housing, accessible health care, and modern infrastructure and schools.
He listed health care, social services, economy and labor policy, and technology as the areas of public policy he is most passionate about.
